newsitem.title: DUBAI: Two killed, five injured in Saudi drugs raid.
newsitem.headline: Two killed, five injured in Saudi drugs raid.

text.p: A Saudi policeman and an alleged drugs dealer were killed and five others were injured on Thursday in a shootout between police and a suspected narcotics gang, Saudi official television said.

Quoting a statement by an interior ministry official to the state-run Saudi news agency SPA, it said police carried out several raids in Jeddah province searching for 30 Saudi nationals suspected of belonging to the gang.

The gang resisted arrest and shot at police, who returned fire. Five alleged gang members were injured, one of whom died later in hospital. A police major was also shot dead and a second police officer injured, the television said.
Police were able to arrest all remaining suspects.
The television did not say what kind of drugs were allegedly involved or whether any narcotics were confiscated.
